title: Erase
description: A handwritten setlist taped above a ledge, one song already half rubbed out. Scrub across a title and the ink lifts off as fine dust that drifts down into a pile at the foot of the page; undo pulls every grain back up into its letter.
intent: Erasing as matter: rubbing energy becomes ink dust and eraser crumbs that fall under gravity and heap up with a real angle of repose, the page keeps a ghost and roughened fibre where you rubbed, and undo is the dust flying home.
